about: The library of structured rule templates. Rule.template holds a key from this file and Rule.params must match that template's params schema (JSON Schema). 'solver' says whether the scheduling engine enforces the template today ('enforced', for the scopes listed) or whether it is saved and shown but not yet enforced ('stored').

templates.label: Max clinical hours in any 7 days
templates.sentence: No more than {hours} scheduled clinical hours in any rolling 7-day period

templates.label: One 24-hour period off every 7 days
templates.sentence: At least one continuous 24 hours free of shifts and academic time in every 7 days
templates.solverNote: Always on in the engine; it cannot be switched off.

templates.label: Rest after a shift relative to its length
templates.sentence: Time off after a shift is at least {ratio} x the length of that shift

templates.label: Min hours off between shifts
templates.sentence: At least {hours} hours off between shifts
templates.solverNote: Enforced as a hard program-wide rule. Role, participant and soft versions are stored only.

templates.label: Max consecutive shifts
templates.sentence: No more than {n} shifts on consecutive days

templates.label: Max shifts per week
templates.sentence: No more than {n} shifts in any 7 days

templates.label: Max shifts per interval
templates.sentence: No more than {n} shifts in the interval

templates.label: No night shift followed by a day shift
templates.sentence: A night shift is never followed by a day shift the next day
templates.solverNote: In practice already covered by the rest rule and the forward-rotation goal.

templates.label: Max night shifts per interval
templates.sentence: No more than {n} night shifts in the interval

templates.label: Max runs of nights per interval
templates.sentence: No more than {n} separate runs of night shifts in the interval

templates.label: Max nights in a row
templates.sentence: No more than {n} night shifts in a row
templates.solverNote: The engine has the soft version as part of 'single run of nights'.

templates.label: One run of nights per person
templates.sentence: Aim for a single run of nights per person, at most {max_length} nights long

templates.label: Days between runs of nights
templates.sentence: At least {days} days between runs of nights

templates.label: Max share of nights
templates.sentence: No more than {percent}% of a person's scheduled hours are nights

templates.label: No night shift heading into vacation
templates.sentence: No overnight shift that ends on a vacation day

templates.label: Forward (clockwise) rotation
templates.sentence: Shifts rotate forward (day, evening, swing, night); avoid backward steps from one day to the next

templates.label: Balance days / evenings / nights
templates.sentence: Each person's days, evenings and nights stay within {tolerance_shifts} shift(s) of their fair share

templates.label: Balance two areas
templates.sentence: Each person's shifts in {area_a} and {area_b} stay within {tolerance_shifts} of each other
templates.solverNote: One tolerance applies to every area pair; the engine uses the smallest one set.

templates.label: Keep days off together
templates.sentence: Prefer two or more days off in a row over isolated single days off

templates.label: Weekends worked per interval
templates.sentence: Between {min} and {max} weekends worked in the interval

templates.label: Cannot work (by date, weekday, time, shift type or site)
templates.sentence: Cannot work the matching shifts. Leave a field empty to match everything
templates.solverNote: Enforced when hard. The date range comes from the rule's active dates. Soft versions are stored only. Chief days are this template: Thursdays from 00:00 for 13 hours.

templates.label: Must / must not work with
templates.sentence: {together} be on shift at the same time as {participant_id}

templates.label: Required headcount per shift per role
templates.sentence: {shift_id} needs at least {count} of {role_id}
templates.solverNote: The engine staffs each shift to its total headcount and role eligibility; per-role minimums are not enforced yet.

templates.label: Custom (needs manual review)
templates.sentence: {text}
templates.solverNote: Free text that could not be mapped to a template. Never enforced automatically.
